name: jev-compaction
description: Periodic Jev-guided compaction of long sessions: prunes stale tool calls and results and shortens old message text to keep a 1M-context session in a 120k-200k band, below the engine's own auto-compaction.

triggerTokens.title: Trigger (tokens)
triggerTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: start a periodic compaction when the context reaches this many tokens.

targetTokens.title: Target (tokens)
targetTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: a periodic compaction is applied when it brings the context to this size or less.

hardTokens.title: Hard limit (tokens)
hardTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: at or above this size a compaction that does not end below it falls back to the built-in summary.

triggerPercent.title: Trigger (percent)
triggerPercent.description: Smaller windows: start a periodic compaction at this percentage of the window.

targetPercent.title: Target (percent)
targetPercent.description: Smaller windows: apply a periodic compaction that reaches this percentage or less.

hardPercent.title: Hard limit (percent)
hardPercent.description: Smaller windows: the hard limit as a percentage of the window.

minFreedTokens.title: Minimum tokens freed
minFreedTokens.description: A manual or automatic compaction must free at least this many estimated tokens, else the built-in summary is used.

softMinFreedTokens.title: Periodic minimum freed (tokens)
softMinFreedTokens.description: Windows over 300k tokens: a periodic compaction that misses the target is applied only if it frees this many tokens (a rewrite costs a prompt-cache miss).

softMinFreedPercent.title: Periodic minimum freed (percent)
softMinFreedPercent.description: Smaller windows: the same minimum as a percentage of the window.

regrowTokens.title: Regrowth guard (tokens)
regrowTokens.description: After an attempt, wait until the context has grown by this many tokens beyond it before trying again.

prescoreMarginTokens.title: Pre-scoring margin (tokens)
prescoreMarginTokens.description: From this far below the trigger on, each finished turn asks Jev about part of the backlog, so the compaction at the trigger mostly reuses scores.

prescoreBatches.title: Pre-scoring batches per turn
prescoreBatches.description: At most this many Jev requests are made per turn ahead of time.

prescoreEveryTokens.title: Pre-scoring interval (tokens)
prescoreEveryTokens.description: Pre-score again only after the context has grown by this many tokens since the last pre-score.

prescoreMinQuestions.title: Pre-scoring minimum questions
prescoreMinQuestions.description: Pre-score only when at least this many questions (about one batch) are unscored.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev request timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: One Jev request is abandoned after this long; the compaction then defers or falls back.

jevTotalMs.title: Jev total time (ms)
jevTotalMs.description: Remaining Jev batches are abandoned (their items are kept) once a compaction has spent this long; also held below the hook's time budget.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a tool call, result or message text to be kept verbatim.

abridgeThreshold.title: Abridge threshold
abridgeThreshold.description: Assistant text below the keep threshold but at or above this is abridged; below it, replaced by a one-line stub.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Newest messages kept
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages are never touched (the first message is always kept).

maxStateTokens.title: Jev state ceiling (tokens)
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling of the conversation state sent to Jev.

maxRequestTokens.title: Jev request ceiling (tokens)
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token ceiling of state plus one batch of questions.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result head (characters)
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a truncated tool result that are kept.

textCompression.title: Compress old text
textCompression.description: During a compaction, cut padding, pleasantries and joining words from old assistant text (user text stays verbatim) and let Jev drop sentences that carry nothing from long assistant messages.

sentenceKeepThreshold.title: Sentence keep threshold
sentenceKeepThreshold.description: An old assistant sentence whose Jev probability is below this is dropped (never more than the drop ratio of a message).

maxSentenceDropRatio.title: Maximum sentences dropped
maxSentenceDropRatio.description: The largest share of one message's sentences that may be dropped (0 to 1).

compressOnEntry.title: Compress on entry
compressOnEntry.description: Compress text as it enters the transcript, so the compressed form is the only one ever sent or cached. Master switch for the three kinds below.

entryUser.title: Entry: user prompts
entryUser.description: Word filter only (articles and whitespace, no removals, never a deleted sentence) on your prompts. Off by default.

entryAssistant.title: Entry: assistant text
entryAssistant.description: Word filter and Jev sentence pruning on the assistant's reply text (long replies only for Jev; at most one request per message). Off by default.

entryToolResults.title: Entry: long tool results
entryToolResults.description: Trim long output of noisy Bash commands (test, build, install and log runners; see the allowlist) to its head, tail, failure lines and the chunks Jev keeps. Never Read, Grep, Glob, agents or MCP tools.

entryTimeoutMs.title: Entry Jev timeout (ms)
entryTimeoutMs.description: A Jev request on entry is abandoned after this long and the text enters unpruned.

entryResultMinChars.title: Entry tool result minimum (characters)
entryResultMinChars.description: Only tool output longer than this is trimmed on entry.

entryTrimCommands.title: Entry: commands whose output may be trimmed
entryTrimCommands.description: Regular expression a Bash command must match (at the start of a command) for its long output to be trimmed on entry. Readers such as cat, head, git diff, rg and find are never trimmed. Default: test, build, install and log runners.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name sent to Jev. Default jev-latest.

keyFile.title: Key file
keyFile.description: Path of a file with KEY=value lines holding JEV_COMPACTION_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Default: $HOME/.config/ai-tools/jev-compaction.env.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Ongoing task description given to Jev; default the last user prompts.

rotate.title: Rotation: automatic trigger
rotate.description: Rotate the session in place when it is due (after rotateAfterHours, or after rotateHighTurns turns at rotateHighTokens or more): the model writes a handover, then old messages are replaced by it. Off by default; `/jev-compact rotate dry` previews and `/jev-compact rotate` applies one rotation by hand.

rotateAfterHours.title: Rotation: hours
rotateAfterHours.description: Rotate once this many hours have passed since the session started or last rotated.

rotateHighTurns.title: Rotation: high turns
rotateHighTurns.description: Rotate after this many main turns at rotateHighTokens or more since the last rotation.

rotateHighTokens.title: Rotation: high-turn size (tokens)
rotateHighTokens.description: A main turn ending at this many context tokens or more counts as a high turn.

rotateKeepMessages.title: Rotation: messages kept
rotateKeepMessages.description: How many of the newest messages a rotation keeps beside the first message and the handover (never fewer than 10).

rotateBudgetTokens.title: Rotation: kept-message budget (tokens)
rotateBudgetTokens.description: Estimated tokens the kept messages may use; above it fewer are kept, down to 10.
